brief:
The Hind Rajab Foundation has called on German authorities to arrest Israeli soldier Almog Keisi, who was sighted in Lüneburg this week, the Middle East Eye reported. The foundation accuses Keisi of war crimes committed during the Gaza conflict.

The appeal invokes Germany's universal jurisdiction laws, which allow prosecution of suspected war criminals regardless of where crimes occurred. The foundation, named after a Palestinian child killed in Gaza, has previously pursued legal cases against Israeli military figures in multiple countries.
